game.name: Kinect Sports (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)(Rev 1)
game.desc: Kinect Sports is a compilation of six sports (football, bowling, athletics, boxing, beach volleyball and table tennis) that can be played solo or with others, locally or online. It is possible to play quick games, mini-games or to get together in a party mode specially dedicated to local multiplayer.
